questions.prompt: Which of these countries have a coast on the Mediterranean Sea?
questions.fact: Portugal faces the Atlantic, Austria has no coast at all, and Romania sits on the Black Sea.

questions.prompt: Which of these animals can fly?
questions.fact: Ostriches, penguins and kiwis are all birds, and not one of them can get off the ground.

questions.prompt: In which year did the Titanic sink?
questions.fact: She struck the iceberg late on 14 April 1912 and was gone in under three hours.

questions.prompt: How many years ago did the last dinosaurs die out, in millions?
questions.fact: About 66 million years ago, after an asteroid struck what is now Mexico. Birds are the dinosaurs that made it through.

questions.prompt: Which metal is liquid at room temperature?
questions.hint: It shares its name with a planet.
questions.fact: Mercury freezes at about minus 39 degrees, which is why it stays liquid in a warm room.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the play Romeo and Juliet?
questions.hint: He was writing in England around 1595.
questions.fact: Shakespeare did not invent the story. He took it from an English poem published thirty years earlier.
